notes.title: v2.0.1
notes.content:
Just a list of minor fixes/improvements that should have been done 6 months ago
- Fixed issues with medals not showing up
- Added a complete restart button that resets all progress, including leaderboard, in settings
- Leaderboard place is shown in the level selected screen
- Made secrets a bit easier
- Minor bug fixes

Reminder that Freight Hopper is Unlicensed and open source https://github.com/Husky-Game-Studio/Freight-Hopper

notes.title: 2.0.0 Leaderboards, Achievements, And Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Update 2.0.0![/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added leaderboards
[*] Added multiplayer, join via in-game steam overlay. It's nothing advanced, you can see your friends whenever you are on the same levels
[*] Added [strike]5[/strike] 4 achievements
[*] Cloud save for game data (though leaderboards will save your times too)
[/list] 
Changes
[list]
[*] Revamped graphics through Unity 2021 Upgrade
[*] Level edits for all 10 levels
[*] Updated movement, you can now slow down midair. Movement is snappier
[*] Many bug fixes related to movement
[*] Decreased memory usage
[*] Increase cpu usage (decreased gpu usage!)
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
In the next update 2.1, we will focus more on additional levels and performance. The current project is difficult to work with in regard to level editing. So we hope to improve this and massively boost CPU performance.

This project is a hobby side project for us. We hope to deliver more updates but don't expect anything too soon. This project is open source at [url=https://github.com/Husky-Game-Studio/Freight-Hopper]our Github[/url] and open to contribution. Interested in speaking to us to provide feedback? You can reach us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/FXefTW3WcG]our discord[/url].
